name: ez-core
description: Core working skills: wdyr (researched recommendations), auto-run (work without stopping), ccf (group changed files into commits)

research_dir.title: wdyr research folder
research_dir.description: Folder where wdyr saves each recommendation's research. Leave empty to save only when your instructions name a folder.

org_repo.title: ccf org repo
org_repo.description: Repo that `ccf org` uses. Leave empty if you have none.

project_dirs.title: ccf project folders
project_dirs.description: Comma-separated folders that hold project repos, so `ccf <project>` finds <folder>/<project>.

daily_logs.title: ccf daily logs
daily_logs.description: Comma-separated globs with YYYYMMDD (e.g. time/YYYYMMDD.md). Today's file is left out of commits; earlier days are grouped.
